assertion_review.failure_condition: Fixture roots directly contain the worktree or an ancestor, masking omission in launch_plan; guards fixture representativeness.

False or absent key adds Edit/MultiEdit disallow or changes baseline argv; four failures recorded under unconditional-disallow mutation. Root suffix shares the existing filter and does not independently test its policy.

Server registration omits worktree or a delivery root, changes module invocation, or fails to serialize the roots. Expected roots share the unmodified filter, so this is wiring coverage; reinstating omission still fails because expected roots explicitly include worktree.
Eligible launch fails to record enabled treatment.
Treatment argv lacks built-in edit restriction flag; existing test :164 verifies its exact contents.
Restoring old root computation refuses the source read; recorded reproduction fails here for both dialects.
Read does not return source content or anchored rendering; expected text comes from fixture bytes, not the tool output.
Edit through configured roots refuses the valid source replacement.
Successful response leaves original bytes or writes wrong content; independent filesystem read verifies persistence, despite expected replacement matching edit input.
Outside operator path is accepted, for example if server roots accidentally include fixture ancestor.
Outside refusal is caused by a different error rather than root confinement.
